settings.title: Designed by ex-Cervélo engineers
settings.sub: Kevin Quan, who designed the Cervélo P-Series, drew this frame.

settings.title: Direct-to-consumer pricing
settings.sub: No dealer markup. You pay for the bike, not the showroom.

settings.title: Free fit support & size exchanges
settings.sub: Talk to a real fitter before and after you buy. Wrong size? Swap it free.

settings.title: Lifetime frame warranty + crash replacement
settings.sub: Honored directly by us. Damage it in a crash and we replace the frame.

settings.quote: My first carbon tri bike. I'm not a pro — I just wanted to stop getting dropped on the bike leg. It fit out of the box once I used their sizing call, and I genuinely felt faster.
settings.name: Marcus T.

settings.quote: Honest take: assembly took me about an hour and the headset needed patience. But for the money there's nothing close. The SAGS cockpit let me get low without buying parts.
settings.name: Dana R.

settings.quote: Shopped the Cervélo and QR at my local shop and walked out because of the price. Glad I waited. Mechanical 105 just works, and support actually answered when I had a routing question.
settings.name: Priya S.

settings.title: Frame & fork
settings.rows:
Material | Hand-laid Toray T700 carbon fiber
Frame weight | 1,250 g (size M, painted)
Tube profiles | Truncated-airfoil (kammtail) down tube, seat tube & fork
Routing | Fully internal cable & hose
Designer | Kevin Quan (former Cervélo P-Series engineer)

settings.title: Drivetrain
settings.rows:
Groupset | Shimano 105 R-7000, 11-speed mechanical
Front derailleur | Shimano 105 R-7000
Rear derailleur | Shimano 105 R-7000
Crankset | Shimano FC-RS510, 50/34T
Cassette | Shimano 105, 11–28T
Brakes | TRP Spyre mechanical disc, Tektro 140mm rotors

settings.title: Wheels & tires
settings.rows:
Wheelset | Vision Team 30 alloy, tubeless-ready
Axles | 12mm thru-axle, front & rear
Upgrade path | Accepts standard wheelsets — many owners add deep aero wheels for race day

settings.title: Cockpit & fit (SAGS)
settings.rows:
Stem | A2 SAGS Stem — 140mm fore/aft adjustment
Handlebars | Profile Design Wing/10A
Base bar | Aero alloy, internally routed
Saddle | WTB Rocket V

settings.title: Geometry & sizing
settings.rows:
Sizes | Small · Medium · Large · XL
Rider range | ~5'1" to 6'4" (155–193 cm)
Size M fits | ~5'7"–5'10"
Sizing help | Free remote fit call + size calculator; free exchanges

settings.title: In the box & assembly
settings.rows:
Pre-assembly | Ships 92% assembled
You install | Seatpost, cockpit, and brake dial-in — the headset & stem are the fiddly parts, so take your time with the included torque wrench
Typical setup time | Under an hour with the included video guide
Prefer a shop? | Most local shops finish the build for $50–150
